item.description:
### Added - **Devin sessions now show what they're doing.** Until now a Devin session appeared in the list but always sat at "Idle", because nothing Perch could read said whether it was mid-task. It now goes to work and back to idle as it happens, tells you what it's running, shows its to-do list, and sends the "finished" alert when it's done — the same as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. Nothing to switch on. - **Clicking a Devin session opens its terminal.** It used to open the folder in Finder instead. - **Devin appears in Stats.** The heatmap, streaks, active days, token totals and favourite model all include it now, and the first scan after updating fills in your past Devin sessions — so all-time totals will jump and older days in the heatmap will darken. One quirk worth knowing: a Devin session joins Stats when it ends, not while it's running, because that's when Devin writes its record. - **Devin usage bars.** Your weekly and daily quota, and your plan name, next to the Claude, Codex and Cursor bars — on the Mac, iPhone and watch. Perch uses the login Devin already stored on this Mac and never changes it.
### Note - Perch can't ask Devin for permission the way it does for Claude Code and Codex, so Approve/Deny from your phone or watch still doesn't apply to Devin — Devin has no way to hand a prompt to another app. The low-usage warning tracks your *weekly* quota; the daily one is shown but doesn't trigger an alert.
